'''Jemboc''', also known as '''Jem''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[prisoner]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] that served time on [[Narkina 5]]. He worked in [[Unit Five-Two-D]], at [[Table Five]]. Jemboc was the swing, operating the console that fed new components onto the table to be worked on.<ref name="Episode 8" />

{{Char-stub}}
